name: Trent Ltd
basis: Consolidated (Screener). Standalone = Westside, Zudio and other fashion concepts; Star (Trent Hypermarket, 50:50 with Tesco) and the Inditex associates (Zara, Massimo Dutti) are equity-accounted.

sources.title: Apparel Resources: Trent bets on rapid store expansion (AGM, 23-Jun-2026)
Outlook Business: Noel Tata signals retirement as Trent chairman at AGM
Business Today: Trent shares slump over 12% after Q1 FY27 business update

business.westside: Department-store fashion brand, ~24k sq ft average store, own brands across women, men, kids, home and beauty; 300 stores, 7.26 mn sq ft, 97 cities at Mar-26; online >6% of Westside revenue (Westside.com and Tata Neu), +25% in Q4FY26.
business.zudio: Value fashion, 10,000-12,000 sq ft stores, almost entirely India-sourced own brands at sharp price points, no discounting and little advertising; 963 stores in 310 Indian cities and 3 UAE cities (6 UAE stores) at Mar-26; 76 new cities in FY26; >80% of new stores in Tier II-III towns and peripheral micro-markets; capital per new store Rs3-4 cr incl. capex, deposits and inventory.
business.others: Samoh (occasion wear), Burnt Toast (youth fashion) and other concepts: 23 stores at Mar-26, 29 at Jun-26; newer brands need another two to three years to reach scale (AGM 2026, per Apparel Resources).
business.emergingNote: Beauty and personal care, innerwear and footwear: over 21% of revenue (Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 presentations); FY26 units: beauty 86 mn, innerwear 58 mn, footwear 29 mn (AR FY26 KPI page).

spsfFY26.note: Annualised fashion sales per sq ft, FY26 (AR FY26)

business.star: Food and grocery under the Star banner, run by Trent Hypermarket Pvt Ltd (THPL), a 50:50 JV with Tesco, plus stores in Fiora Hypermarket (a subsidiary). 84 stores / 1.44 mn sq ft in 12 cities at Mar-26, 86 at Jun-26; 18,000-24,000 sq ft formats; own brands 74% of sales (Q1FY27); most stores host a Zudio shop-in-shop. THPL total income Rs2,774 cr FY26 (Rs2,699 cr FY25), loss before exceptional items and tax Rs128 cr (Rs92 cr): refits hurt H1, F&V deflation.
business.inditex: Inditex Trent Retail India (Zara; Trent 20% after tendering 94,900 shares in ITRIPL's buyback in FY26): total income Rs2,768 cr FY26 (Rs2,840 cr), total comprehensive income Rs204 cr (Rs299 cr). Massimo Dutti India (associate): income Rs129 cr, profit Rs11.7 cr. Merchandise only from Inditex, brand permit at Inditex's discretion (AR FY26 note 35).
business.masJv: Trent MAS Fashion (JV with MAS Amity, Singapore): innerwear sourcing.
business.booker: Booker India (51%, Tesco 49%): Booker Wholesale cash-and-carry; total income Rs199 cr FY26.

q1fy27.context: Uncertainty from West Asia (oil, supply chain) early in the quarter; consumers 'prioritising value'; 'escalation in the cost levels of select inputs', mitigated by sourcing and 'calibrating the price architecture'. New markets mature over two to three years; Trent targets revenue growth in micro-markets rather than same-store growth. No material shift in competitive intensity.
q1fy27.src: Q1FY27 presentation (6-Aug-2026); Screener consolidated and standalone quarterly results; MOSL (6-Aug-2026) and ICICI Direct (7-Aug-2026) result notes via DSIJ for gross margin and revenue per sq ft

guidance.storeAdds: AGM (23-Jun-2026): ~50 Westside and 200-250 Zudio stores a year and 25-40 Star stores; medium-term ambition ~700 Westside and ~5,000 Zudio stores (from ~300 and ~960); long-term goal of a ten-fold larger business (Apparel Resources, 24-Jun-2026). Q1FY27 presentation: annual openings 'broadly consistent' with the Chairman's outlook; quarters are uneven.
guidance.lfl: Apparel Resources reported an AGM aim of 11-13% annual like-for-like growth; we could not confirm it in a company document and it sits far above the 'low single digits' reported for FY26 and Q1FY27. Not used.
guidance.margins: Stable price architecture and 'a relatively stable margin profile over time'; staff-cost efficiencies 'largely realised' (Q4FY26).
guidance.capitalRaise: Board approved in principle (22-Apr-2026) raising c.Rs2,500 cr of equity (rights issue or otherwise) for store upgrades, new brands/categories/geographies, supply chain and automation, and faster Star roll-out incl. retail real estate; timing to be decided. Not launched by 30-Sep-2026.
